from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """One court document with its title and assigned case type(s)."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g. 《判决文书 1》)")
    case_types: list[str] = Field(description="The case type(s) this document belongs to; one of '赔偿案件', '刑事案件', '民事案件', '行政案件', '管辖案件'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
